items.title: GoldBod rejects funding crisis claims, says gold purchases remain on course
items.description: The Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) has rejected reports that funding constraints are disrupting gold purchases by licensed buyers, saying its trade-financing arrangements remain operational and that purchases of artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) gold are continuing. The clarification follows reports on August 24, 2026, which suggested that some companies licensed to purchase gold for GoldBod had experienced funding delays of up to three weeks, with some operators reportedly suspending purchases or resorting to borrowing to finance their activities. In a rejoinder on Monday, August 24, GoldBod said the report appeared to conflate its own trade-financing arrangements with separate credit arrangements between licensed aggregators and downstream buyers. It said the distinction was important because direct financing from GoldBod is available only to licensed aggregators, rather than every company operating under its gold-buying framework. Gold purchases remain ongoing’ Despite the concerns raised in the reports, GoldBod maintained that its statutory operations remain fully active. “The GoldBod maintains a robust financial standing and continues to purchase and aggregate Artisanal and Small-scale Mining (ASM) gold through its licensed buyers in accordance with its statutory mandate,” the statement said. The Board said it remained committed to financial discipline, accountability, transparency and prudent risk management while safeguarding public resources and maintaining the integrity of Ghana’s formal gold-trading system. It therefore rejected suggestions that it had abandoned or was incapable of financing its statutory gold-purchasing mandate and asked Reuters to update its reporting to reflect the clarification. Two aggregators receive direct financing GoldBod said its licensing framework has four categories of participants — Aggregators, Self-Financing Aggregators, Tier 1 Buyers and Tier 2 Buyers. According to the statement by GoldBod, there are currently two licensed aggregators operating under the framework and eligible to receive direct GoldBod trade financing to purchase and aggregate gold for onwards delivery to the Board. It said any difficulty encountered by Tier 1 or Tier 2 buyers in accessing working capital from an aggregator should therefore not be interpreted as a financing failure by GoldBod. “The GoldBod’s institutional responsibility is to ensure that its approved financing is properly deployed, monitored and recovered within the applicable financing and risk-management framework,” the statement said. Downstream buyers not automatically entitled to funding GoldBod further explained that licensed buyers outside the aggregator category do not have an automatic entitlement to indirect financing from the Board. Where such buyers require financing to purchase gold for onward supply through an aggregator, the financing is arranged directly with the relevant aggregator. Such arrangements, GoldBod said, constitute commercial credit transactions, with aggregators determining whether to extend, vary, suspend or decline financing based on factors including the buyer’s creditworthiness, outstanding obligations, available security and the aggregator’s risk appetite. The Board consequently rejected any suggestion that a downstream buyer’s inability to access or draw down such financing amounted to a shortfall in GoldBod’s funding. New controls introduced GoldBod also pointed to new financing and risk-management controls introduced on July 22, 2026, which took effect on August 1. The measures, it said, were intended to strengthen accountability, improve credit-risk management and protect public funds within the gold-purchasing chain. Under the revised framework, eligible buyers seeking financing through an aggregator must hold a valid GoldBod licence and undergo Know Your Customer (KYC), due-diligence and creditworthiness assessments. They are also required to sign formal trade-financing agreements, comply with reporting and repayment requirements and, where necessary, provide security such as bank guarantees, advance payment guarantees or insurance bonds. Existing beneficiaries were similarly required to regularise their participation in the financing programme and settle outstanding obligations within the prescribed period. GoldBod said the tighter requirements should not be viewed as a withdrawal of financial support but as measures to ensure that public funds are extended only to eligible and creditworthy participants.

items.title: I await courage from accusers to report ‘extortion’ claims – Afenyo-Markin
items.description: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin says he is awaiting the courage of those who have accused him of extortion to formally report the matter to the appropriate investigative authorities. Speaking during Parliament’s emergency recall sitting, Mr Afenyo-Markin said he is prepared to submit himself to any investigation if the allegations are formally lodged with the Police, the Office of the Special Prosecutor (OSP), or any other competent investigative agency. “I also await with bated breath that the man or the men who made the allegation will have the courage to report the matter to the police or the OSP or any investigating agency in this country,” he said on Monday, August 24, 2026. He added, “I expect that if they muster the courage to report that I have extorted from them and I am invited, I shall submit myself to every investigation so that eventually my name is cleared.” Mr Afenyo-Markin said he has already taken legal steps in response to the allegations, describing his decision to pursue the matter through the courts as taking the “high moral ground.” He disclosed that writs had been filed in two separate cases involving individuals and media organisations over the allegations. One of the suits, numbered GT 1029/2026, is titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin versus Samuel Adu Gyamfi and Multimedia Group Limited and was filed at the Accra High Court. The second, numbered GR/ACH/CC/C5/02/2026, is titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin versus Eric Adjei and Peace FM and was filed at the Achimota Circuit Court. The Minority Leader said he has confidence that the courts will ultimately determine the merits of the matters. He also cautioned against crossing what he described as the limits of political discourse, insisting that allegations of this nature should be addressed through lawful processes. “There is a limit to political discourse. There are lines that must not be crossed, and these red lines, once crossed, they must be dealt with,” he said. Mr Afenyo-Markin further defended his record in public office, saying he has served as Minority Leader with integrity and a clear conscience. “I can modestly and humbly say that I have served in this position with integrity,” he stated. He maintained that he entered the position with a commitment to hard work and determination and has remained faithful to the responsibilities entrusted to him. The Minority Leader’s comments come amid calls for investigations into allegations of extortion made against him, with proponents of a probe arguing that the appropriate state institutions should establish the facts surrounding the claims.

items.title: Prince Harry steps down from African wildlife charity board
items.description: The Duke of Sussex has stepped down from the board of an African wildlife charity whose rangers had been found to have committed human rights abuses against indigenous people. A spokesman for Prince Harry confirmed he was stepping down after being president for the charity, African Parks, for six years before becoming a member of its board of directors in 2023, but said he remains a “supporter of its mission”. Last year the organisation admitted human rights abuses were committed by its rangers in Congo-Brazzaville. Prince Harry’s resignation comes shortly after it was announced he was relocating with the Duchess of Sussex, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet from California to the UK. Prince Harry’s spokesman said “the Duke is proud of his 10 years with African Parks and fully supports the ongoing strengthening of its board. “His commitment to conservation in Africa continues, and he remains a supporter of African Parks’ mission.” African Parks manages around 20 national parks and protected areas across 12 countries. It was subject to an independent human rights investigation into allegations guards managed and paid by the charity had beaten, raped and tortured indigenous people in the Odzala-Kokoua National Park. The charity said in 2025 it had improved its safeguarding processes both in the Odzala-Kokoua National Park and institutionally. Announcing a “governance refresh of its board of directors”, the charity thanked Prince Harry for his association, saying he had “brought global attention to the urgent need for biodiversity protection for the benefit of people and wildlife, and has contributed greatly to promoting philanthropy for the cause of conservation in Africa”. It added: “The duke remains deeply committed to this cause, and remains a strong supporter of African Parks’ work.” The charity’s website says Prince Harry served as part of the expert team that helped implement the first phase of the 500 Elephants project, which was “one of the largest and most significant elephant translocations in conservation history”. It saw wildlife experts move elephants from a park in Malawi to help increase population in areas where they have been heavily poached. Prince Harry has said helping move elephants to safer homes was an “amazing” experience. The Sussexes are back in the spotlight after the revelation last week they were returning to the UK this month after enrolling their children to start at a British school in September. No change is expected to the official status of Prince Harry and Meghan and they will remain as private individuals. Their pending return to the UK has raised questions on their security arrangements. Last year, Prince Harry lost a legal challenge over the levels of security he and his family are entitled to while in the UK. It is unclear what provisions will be made for their security once they return to the UK. The couple’s plans while they are in the UK are also unclear. The BBC learned the Duchess of Sussex was in talks to return to acting with a role in Netflix series The Gentlemen, which would be her first significant acting role since her marriage to Prince Harry. In early 2020, the Sussexes left the UK and stepped back from their royal duties before settling in California in March that year.

items.title: Décès de Noaga Marcel BOUDA : Programme des obsèques
items.description: La grande famille BOUDA à Villy Nongtaaba, Koudougou ; Le Patriarche Sanaaba Sousbi, BOUDA Daniel Noabila, BOUDA Boureima Boussé, BOUDA Alphonse Bombiyamba ; BOUDA Ambroise Winoaga, BOUDA BAGA Clément, BOUDA Soutongo François, BOUDA Alexandre, catéchiste à la retraite, BOUDA M'Bi Victor, BOUDA Yamba François, BOUDA François Koudraogo ; Le catéchiste KOLOGO Bewêntaore Constant ; La veuve Madame BOUDA Rozalie née ZOUNDI, à Koudougou. LES FILS ET FILLES – BOUDA Jean Baptiste, à Bobo-Dioulasso, et son épouse- BOUDA Benjamin, à Bruxelles, Belgique, et son épouse – BOUDA Jean, à Boston, États-Unis d'Amérique, et son épouse – BOUDA Emilie, épouse NEBIE, à Atlanta, États-Unis d'Amérique – BOUDA Kiswendsida Pauline, épouse KIEMDÉ, à Sapouy, province du Ziro LES PETITS-ENFANTS BOUDA Marie Oceanne, BOUDA Alicia Odile, BOUDA Christelle, BOUDA Aura, BOUDA Noaga Noé, BOUDA Barackwendé Elijah St John, NEBIE Odilia Mary-Regine, NEBIE Olivia Mary-Hope, KIEMDÉ Stanislas, KIEMDÉ Luciano et KIEMDÉ Stella Amelia. Ont la profonde douleur de vous annoncer le décès de leur père, grand-père et arrière-grand-père, BOUDA NOAGA MARCEL, né le 1er janvier 1950, décès survenu le mardi 18 août 2026 au CHU de Bogodogo à Ouagadougou, des suites d'une longue maladie, à l'âge de 76 ans. Ils vous informent que le programme de ses obsèques se déroulera comme suit : MERCREDI 26 AOÛT 2026 – 14h00 : Levée du corps à la morgue du CHU de Bogodogo à Ouagadougou, suivie du transfert de la dépouille mortelle à son domicile familial à Villy Nongtaaba, Koudougou. – 21h00 : Veillée de prière au domicile familial à Villy Nongtaaba. JEUDI 27 AOÛT 2026 – 09h30 : Levée du corps au domicile familial. – 10h00 : Messe d'absoute et de requiem tenant lieu de funérailles chrétiennes, à l'église catholique Saint-Mathieu de Nongtaaba, suivie de l'inhumation au caveau familial à Villy Nongtaaba. – 13h00 : Repas de communion et célébration de sa vie au domicile familial. La famille remercie sincèrement toutes les personnes qui, par leurs prières, leur présence, leurs messages et leurs marques de compassion, les accompagnent dans cette douloureuse épreuve. « Je suis la résurrection et la vie. Celui qui croit en moi, même s'il meurt, vivra. » Jean 11, 25 Que, par la miséricorde de Dieu, l'âme de BOUDA NOAGA MARCEL repose en paix. Union de prières.

items.title: I’ll submit myself to any investigation to clear my name – Afenyo-Markin on ‘extortion’ allegation

His comments follow allegations of extortion and related conduct made by the Chief Executive of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), Sammy Gyamfi, against him. Speaking during Parliament’s emergency recall sitting on Monday, August 24, 2026, Afenyo-Markin said he would cooperate fully with any investigation should the allegations be formally reported to the appropriate authorities. He challenged those who have accused him of extortion to report the matter to the Police, the Office of the Special Prosecutor (OSP), or any other competent investigative agency. “If they muster the courage to report that I have extorted from them and I am invited, I shall submit myself to every investigation so that eventually my name is cleared,” he said. Mr Afenyo-Markin said he has already chosen to pursue the matter through lawful channels, following the allegations against him. He disclosed that he has caused writs to be filed in two separate cases involving individuals and media organisations over the claims. One of the suits, numbered GT 1029/2026, is titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin versus Samuel Adu-Gyamfi and Multimedia Group Limited and was filed at the Accra High Court. The second suit, GR/ACH/CC/C5/02/2026, is titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin versus Eric Agjei and Peace FM and was filed at the Achimota Circuit Court. According to the Minority Leader, he is confident the courts will make the appropriate determination on the matters. He described his decision to submit himself to legal processes as taking the “high moral ground” in the face of the allegations. Mr Afenyo-Markin also cautioned against what he described as unacceptable lines being crossed in political discourse. “There is a limit to political discourse. There are lines that must not be crossed, and these red lines, once crossed, they must be dealt with,” he said. He further defended his record as Minority Leader, saying he has served in the position with integrity, hard work and a clear conscience. “I have served in this position with integrity,” he stated, adding that he has remained faithful to the responsibilities entrusted to him.

items.title: NAIMOS arrests 3, destroys 86 Chanfang machines in Ablebo galamsey sweep
items.description: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) has intensified its crackdown on illegal mining (galamsey), destroying 86 Chanfang machines, 11 water pumps and two makeshift structures during an operation at Ablebo in the Nzema East Municipality of the Western Region. Three persons were also arrested during the operation conducted on August 22, 2026, as part of ongoing reconnaissance and enforcement activities to identify, disrupt and dismantle illegal mining operations across the country. The operation covered about 35 kilometres of the Ablebo General Area, where the security team conducted a reconnaissance patrol to assess the scale of illegal mining and gather intelligence on activities in the area. Illegal miners caught by surprise According to the operation report, the NAIMOS team took the illegal miners by surprise when it entered the area and encountered several sites where mining activities were actively ongoing. The operatives subsequently moved in to disrupt the activities and dismantle the machinery being used. In all, 86 Chanfang machines and 11 water pumps were destroyed, while two makeshift structures associated with the mining activities were also dismantled. Some of the equipment was removed from the sites by personnel of the Ghana Integrated Iron and Steel Development Corporation (GIISDEC), while other equipment was set ablaze during the operation. The three suspects arrested in connection with the activities were transported to the Axim Police Station, where they were handed over to the police for further investigation and possible prosecution. Ankobra water body at risk The operation has also highlighted continuing concerns over the impact of illegal mining on the environment, particularly the Ankobra River, which is identified as an affected water body in the area. Illegal mining, commonly referred to as galamsey, has continued to pose significant environmental challenges in parts of Ghana, with mining activities often involving the use of heavy machinery and watercourses. The Ablebo operation, according to NAIMOS, was therefore not only aimed at stopping illegal mining activities but also at gathering intelligence to support subsequent enforcement action. In his report on the operation, the team leader, 2/Lt. B.A. Apedele, said the reconnaissance patrol had successfully disrupted illegal mining activities within the Ablebo General Area and cleared substantial quantities of equipment from the affected sites. More enforcement expected The arrest of the three suspects is expected to provide investigators with information that could assist in tracing individuals and networks connected to illegal mining activities in the area. NAIMOS said the operation underscored the importance of sustained reconnaissance, monitoring and enforcement in mining communities where illegal activities continue to threaten water bodies and the environment. The Ablebo exercise forms part of broader efforts involving NAIMOS and other state security and enforcement agencies to combat illegal mining, protect Ghana’s water resources and support the restoration of degraded mining landscapes. With the 35-kilometre patrol completed and significant quantities of mining equipment destroyed or removed, the operation has disrupted illegal mining activities in the immediate area while providing enforcement authorities with further intelligence on the scale of the problem.

items.title: Alonso makes winning start with Chelsea; Rogers scores on debut
items.description: Xabi Alonso won his first game as Chelsea boss thanks to Morgan Rogers’s debut goal and Joao Pedro’s strike after just 31 seconds of a pulsating 3-2 victory against Fulham on Monday. Alonso has been hired to revive Chelsea after their dismal 10th place finish in the Premier League last season. The former Real Madrid boss has a point to prove after being sacked by the Spanish club following less than eight months in charge. Alonso’s side ensured he delivered a good first impression in a chaotic west London derby at Craven Cottage. Pedro’s opener inside the first minute was followed by a blunder from Chelsea keeper Robert Sanchez that gifted an equaliser to Josh King. Rogers put Chelsea back in front on his debut after becoming the most expensive British player in history following his £117 million ($159 million) move from Aston Villa in the close-season. Cole Palmer increased Chelsea’s advantage after half-time and the Blues survived a frantic finale after Gonzalo Garcia bagged Fulham’s second goal following another Sanchez mistake. On an evening when old friends were reunited on the touchline and on the pitch, Alonso emerged victorious against new Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa. The pals played together for seven years with Real Madrid and Liverpool and also starred for Spain. Ironically, Arbeloa was promoted from Real Madrid B to replace Alonso when he was axed at the Bernabeu in January. Rogers is also close friends with Palmer and the pair gelled immediately to lead a dynamic attacking display from Chelsea. Rogers was deployed on the left of Chelsea’s three-man attack, with Palmer on the right and Pedro in the central role. Palmer endured a difficult last campaign that saw him left out of England’s World Cup squad and he played as if he was determined to make amends. Keeping Rogers and Palmer fit and firing could be the key to Chelsea climbing back into contention for Champions League qualification this season. – ‘Ice-cold’ Rogers – Alonso’s reign got off to a stunning start when Levi Colwill’s header reached Palmer and he flicked a deft pass into the path of Pedro, who timed his run perfectly and clipped a composed finish past Fulham goalkeeper Bernd Leno. But Sanchez is under pressure after some shaky performances last term and the error-prone Spaniard was at fault when Fulham drew level in the 23rd minute. King’s strike was close enough for Sanchez to save but he allowed the ball to squirm into the net. While Chelsea were often left exposed at the back by Alonso’s bold 3-4-3 formation, they attacked with poise and purpose. Romeo Lavia’s effort was superbly saved by Leno before Rogers restored the visitors’ lead in the 41st minute. It was a brilliant move, started by Palmer’s clever turn and pass to debutant defender Maxence Lacroix, whose unexpected burst forward produced a low cross that reached Rogers for a clinical finish from 10 yards. Rogers celebrated with the ‘ice-cold’ gesture that Palmer popularised after borrowing it from his former Manchester City youth team colleague. Not to be out-done by his mate, Palmer bagged Chelsea’s third goal four minutes after half-time. Pedro did well in the build-up, holding the ball long enough for Palmer to burst into the Fulham area and plant a low shot past Leno from a tight angle. Fulham reduced the deficit in the 54th minute thanks to another howler by Sanchez. Timothy Castagne’s shot was weakly pushed out by the keeper and Garcia pounced to head in the rebound on his debut after signing from Real Madrid. Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez came off the bench to deafening boos from Fulham fans after his provocative role in Argentina’s World Cup semi-final win over England. King nearly levelled for Fulham with a long-range rocket that fizzed just wide before Antonee Robinson’s lob over Sanchez drifted narrowly wide. items.title: Aïd Al Mawlid Annabawi : Grâce Royale au profit de 634 personnes
items.description: A l'occasion de l’Aïd Al Mawlid Annabawi, le Roi Mohammed VI, que Dieu L'assiste, a bien voulu accorder Sa grâce à 634 personnes dont certaines sont en détention et d’autres en liberté, condamnées par différents tribunaux du Royaume, annonce le ministère de la Justice dans un communiqué. En voici le texte : « A l’occasion de l’Aïd Al Mawlid Annabawi de cette année 1448H – 2026G, Sa Majesté le Roi Mohammed VI, que Dieu perpétue Sa gloire, a bien voulu accorder Sa grâce à un ensemble de personnes condamnées par différents tribunaux du Royaume. Ces personnes sont au nombre de 619 et se présentent comme suit: * Les bénéficiaires de la Grâce Royale qui sont en détention sont au nombre de 462 détenus se répartissant comme suit: -Grâce sur le reliquat de la peine d’emprisonnement ou de réclusion au profit de 13 détenus. -Remise de la peine d’emprisonnement ou de réclusion au profit de 449 détenus. * Les bénéficiaires de la Grâce Royale qui sont en liberté sont au nombre de 157 personnes se répartissant comme suit : -Grâce sur la peine d’emprisonnement ou son reliquat au profit de 28 personnes. -Grâce sur la peine d’emprisonnement avec maintien de l’amende au profit de 13 personnes. -Grâce sur la peine d’amende au profit de 112 personnes. -Grâce sur la peine d’emprisonnement et d’amende au profit de 04 personnes. En cette glorieuse occasion, Sa Majesté le Roi, que Dieu Le préserve, a bien voulu accorder Sa Grâce à des détenus condamnés dans des affaires d’extrémisme et de terrorisme, qui ont obtenu l’Approbation Royale après avoir officiellement exprimé leur attachement aux constantes et aux sacralités de la Nation et aux institutions nationales, révisé leurs orientations idéologiques et rejeté l’extrémisme et le terrorisme. Ils sont au nombre de 15 personnes, se répartissant comme suit: -Grâce sur le reliquat de la peine privative au profit de 09 détenus. -Remise de la peine privative au profit de 06 détenus. Puisse Dieu garder Sa Majesté le Roi, source de clémence et de miséricorde, perpétuer Sa gloire et préserver Son Altesse Royale le Prince Héritier Moulay El Hassan, ainsi que tous les membres de la Famille Royale ». items.title: Rabat : Le Roi préside une veillée religieuse en commémoration de l’Aïd Al-Mawlid Annabaoui Acharif
items.description: e Roi Mohammed VI, Amir Al-Mouminine, accompagné du Prince Héritier Moulay El Hassan, du Prince Moulay Rachid et du Prince Moulay Ahmed, a présidé, lundi 11 Rabie-Ier 1448 de l’Hégire, correspondant au 24 août 2026, au Palais Royal à Rabat, une veillée religieuse en commémoration de l’Aïd Al-Mawlid Annabaoui Acharif. Cette veillée religieuse a été marquée par la déclamation de versets du Saint Coran et de panégyriques du Prophète Sidna Mohammed, Prière et Bénédiction sur Lui. A cette occasion, le ministre des Habous et des Affaires islamiques, Ahmed Toufiq, a prononcé devant Sa Majesté le Roi une allocution dans laquelle il a présenté le bilan des activités du Conseil supérieur et des Conseils locaux des Oulémas. Dans son allocution, le ministre a indiqué que le Roi, Amir Al Mouminine, avait, à l'occasion de la célébration de l’Aid Al Mawlid Annabaoui de l'année dernière, bien voulu charger le Conseil Supérieur des Oulémas d'entreprendre de multiples actions pour commémorer l’anniversaire du quinzième siècle de la naissance du Prophète, que la prière et la paix soient sur Lui. Toufiq a souligné, dans ce cadre, que tout au long de l’année, il a été procédé, conformément aux Hautes Orientations du Roi, à la tenue de grandes assemblées où ont été élevées des prières en hommage au Prophète et prêchées les hautes moralités du Sceau des Messagers. Le ministre a affirmé que l’indéfectible attachement manifesté par la Nation marocaine au Prophète s’illustre à travers deux expressions au fondement religieux, l’une d’ordre politique et l’autre à portée émotionnelle. L’expression d’ordre politique, a-t-il expliqué, réside dans la perpétuation de l’héritage de la Commanderie des Croyants, dont sont dépositaires les descendants du Prophète, alors que celle à portée émotionnelle se traduit par la mise en avant par les Marocains des nobles vertus du Messager de Dieu, à travers les livres des deux savants marocains originaires de la ville de Sebta, à savoir Cadi Ayad (« Traité sur les vertus curatives de la connaissance des droits du Prophète ») et Abou Abbès Al Ozfi (« Anthologie de poèmes composés en célébration de la naissance de l’Illustre prophète »), outre l’ouvrage de l’Imam Jazouli « Les guides vers les voies du Bien », dont les Marocains ont su brandir les prières qu’il contenait dans leur lutte sacrée pour libérer les villes occupées situées le long de l’océan atlantique au début de l’ère contemporaine. Et le ministre de poursuivre que la Nation marocaine, qui a cherché naturellement refuge dans la guidance du Prophète par l'obéissance comme témoignage de l’amour voué au Sceau des Messagers, atteste aujourd'hui que ses oulémas et savants, profondément conscients de la quintessence des paroles du Prophète Sidna Mohammed, paix et bénédictions soient sur Lui, œuvrent, dans le cadre du plan de communication « Tassdid Tabligh » à convaincre les gens, avec la plus grande clarté et simplicité, que le monothéisme sur lequel reposent le Saint Coran et la mission du Prophète, s'illustre par la libération morale de l'égoïsme aussi bien individuel que collectif, une libération qui favorise une réforme concrète de la religiosité. Le ministre des Habous et des Affaires islamiques a, ensuite, remis au Souverain l’ouvrage en arabe « Dakhirat Al Muhtaj Fi Assalati Ala Sahibi Alliwae Wa Taj », édité par le ministère des Habous et des Affaires islamiques, en se référant à des dizaines de manuscrits conservés dans des bibliothèques royales, publiques et privées, au Maroc et à l'étranger. Cette publication fait suite aux Hautes Orientations du Roi, que Dieu Le préserve, qui avait appelé, l'année dernière, dans une Lettre adressée au Conseil supérieur des Oulémas, à la commémoration du 15e siècle de la naissance du Prophète Sidna Mohammed, que la Prière et la Paix soient sur Lui, notamment à travers la publication de livres et ouvrages du patrimoine marocain, relatifs aux prières sur le Prophète et aux œuvres des oulémas et savants marocains en la matière. Cette veillée religieuse s’est déroulée en présence du Chef du gouvernement, des Présidents des deux Chambres du Parlement, de Conseillers du Roi, des membres du gouvernement, des présidents des Instances Constitutionnelles, des Officiers supérieurs de l’Etat-Major général des Forces Armées Royales, des membres du corps diplomatique islamique accrédités à Rabat, ainsi que de plusieurs oulémas et des personnalités civiles et militaires. La célébration de cette veillée religieuse par le Roi Mohammed VI, Amir Al-Mouminine, s’inscrit dans la tradition observée par Ses Illustres Ancêtres qui ont constamment veillé à commémorer l’anniversaire de la venue au Monde du Messager de la Miséricorde, le Prophète Sidna Mohammed, que la Prière et la Paix soient sur Lui. Un anniversaire qui marque l’éclosion des lumières de la guidance pour l’Humanité, grâce au message porté par le Sceau des Prophètes, pour répandre les hautes vertus et les valeurs de justice et recommander les bonnes actions pour que l’ensemble des humains vivent dans la paix et l’entente. items.title: I Lost the Password to My Password’s Password
items.description: One afternoon earlier this month, I pulled up to the rec center and realized that I had a problem. It was not the three boisterous tweens in the back seat who were clamoring to be set loose in the basketball gym. It was my parking app. I had somehow gotten logged out of Passport Parking, which has become the only way to pay for a spot in much of my town, and it was demanding a four-digit PIN to let me back in. My first guess drew a warning message in red letters: “Invalid PIN. PIN cannot contain 4 sequential numbers, 2 repeated digits, or the last 4 digits of your phone number.” I searched my trusty password manager, which was supposed to spare me these predicaments, but it came up empty. By that point, the kids had run ahead and piled themselves against the gym door, waiting for me to let them in. Lately, the process of accessing apps and websites has grown dizzying. “I’m in password hell,” a colleague confided to me recently. “Every login attempt is playing the lottery.” The problem is not just the sheer number of digital accounts, all of which require their own password, ideally unique and unguessable (which usually also means un-memorizable). It’s the pileup of solutions to that problem: all of the different layers of software offering to remember your passwords, the six-digit codes sent to your phone, the authenticator apps, the passkeys. Browsers and operating systems compete with third-party password managers to generate, store, and autofill your credentials. Most of my logins live in 1Password, but others are stored in Apple’s Passwords app (usually by accident), and still others were created via “single sign-on” features such as those offered by Google and Facebook. I vaguely recall certain apps—Facebook is one—prompting me many years ago to copy down a set of “login recovery codes” that would become extremely important should I ever get locked out of my account. Whatever device I stored them on was probably wiped and sold long ago. Logins have always been a hassle. In the 1990s, forgetting your password sometimes meant mailing a po stcard to your service provider and waiting a week or two for it to mail you a new password. In the early 2010s, hackers learned to steal massive troves of logins and then reuse them on other services to steal people’s identities. Things spiraled from there; services started requiring unique, complex passwords with arbitrary requirements. These days, the user experience of logging in is “probably worse than ever,” Troy Hunt, a cybersecurity expert who runs the website Have I Been Pwned, told me. “There’s just no consistency.” Password managers promised a way out, but they often don’t work as seamlessly as you might hope. I click to autofill my password somewhere, and a 1Password authorization appears, only for an iCloud Keychain authorization to pop up directly over it, preventing me from clicking on the 1Password one. When I manually enter a login I thought I remembered, my browser prompts me to remember it; only after I hit “Save” (pro tip: Do not do this) does the website inform me that the password was not recognized. Even when you log in successfully, there’s the tedious dance of waiting for a six-digit authorization code to appear on your phone or in your email, which defeats the concept of a single password for everything. And if you’re somewhere without cell service or you’re sharing a login with someone who isn’t around, you might just be out of luck. All of these steps serve a purpose. At least in theory, each added layer helps prevent hacks and breaches. Erring on the side of safety is worth an amount of inconvenience. At the same time, extra steps can introduce security problems of their own. Last year, Hunt fell for a clever phishing scheme when he clicked a link to log in to his newsletter service. His password manager failed to autofill his information, which should have alerted him that something was wrong, he said. But like the rest of us, he was so used to things not working that he went ahead and manually entered his credentials on a site that turned out to be an impostor, designed to steal and exploit them. None of these obstacles is insurmountable on its own. My problem with Apple’s native password manager fighting with 1Password, for instance, was eventually solved with a 10-minute foray into the bowels of my device settings. But together, they amount to a near-daily irritant. For the less tech-savvy, the situation can be overwhelming. My recent attempts to help my mother fix her password-storage system—which involved loose-leaf notepad sheets full of hand-scrawled credentials scattered around her house like Easter eggs—consumed the better part of a day. By the end, she had all of her credentials updated, validated, and stored in a password manager, just as the experts have been advising for years. But even then, her preferred browser, Google Chrome, showed no interest in surfacing the credentials we had stashed in Apple’s Keychain. And some websites short-circuited her attempts to log in by prompting her to set up a “passkey,” which she interpreted as meaning that her password had failed and she needed to scrap it and set up a new one. Cybersecurity experts will tell you that passkeys—which typically entail logging in to apps or websites with a face or fingerprint scan instead of a password—are the future. When they work properly, they’re both painless and secure. “It may get to a point where we’re all using passkeys and we don’t even know we’re using passkeys,” Lorrie Cranor, a computer-science professor at Carnegie Mellon University who researches privacy and cybersecurity, told me. “I just say ‘Log in’ and I smile at it, and it gets my passkey, and I’m logged in.” But that future isn’t here yet, and in the present, passkeys have added a new layer of frustration. Part of the problem is that virtually no one seems to know what they are. “The fact that even I have trouble explaining them should be a clue,” Cranor said. Her past research on the rollout of two-factor authentication suggests that most people tend to resist new security features for as long as they can. Companies can nudge them, but for websites and apps trying to attract and retain users, pushing people to adopt an unfamiliar authentication technology risks scaring them away. To further complicate matters, passkeys generally aren’t yet replacing passwords altogether, even on sites that use them. Because many passkeys live on your device, one that works on your phone might not work on your laptop, and one that works on your personal laptop might not work on your office device. So you still need a password that works across devices as a backup. It’s a lot, Dave Lewis, 1Password’s global-security adviser, acknowledged to me in an email. “The problem is cognitive overload,” he said. “All these tools are trying to help, but they don’t always work together intuitively.” Still, he disagreed that the situation has never been worse: “When the alternative was using the same password across dozens of accounts or putting it on a sticky note, the fact that people now have password managers, passkeys, biometrics, and multifactor authentication is a good thing.” The mess might compound before it improves. Hacking attempts have been multiplying as crooks harness AI tools. Companies are adding even more security layers that make logging in harder, and they are pleading for people to make the switch to passkeys. On the bright side, maybe the seamless biometric future is actually within sight, and all of our login woes will soon be over. Then again, that’s what we were promised with password managers too.

items.title: Tarifs péage autoroute Dakar-Kaolack : la Société nationale autoroutes du Sénégal dément les rumeurs sur les réseaux sociaux
items.description: La Société nationale autoroutes du Sénégal (SN ADS SA) dément les rumeurs véhiculées sur les réseaux sociaux faisant état d'un tarif aller-retour de 15 000 FCFA pour le péage de l'autoroute Dakar-Kaolack. Les précisions ont été faites à travers une note publiée lundi. La Société nationale autoroutes du Sénégal (SN ADS SA) apporte un démenti catégorique aux informations erronées diffusées récemment sur les réseaux sociaux, faisant état d'un tarif aller-retour de 15 000 FCFA pour le péage de l'autoroute Dakar-Kaolack. « La SN ADS SA tient à rétablir la vérité des faits auprès des usagers de la route et de l'opinion publique : le tarif appliqué pour un véhicule particulier sur le trajet Dakar-Kaolack est de 6 500 FCFA sur un parcours de 184 km, soit 35 FCFA par kilomètre », indique le texte de la SN ADS SA. Concernant le nouveau tronçon Mbour-Kaolack nouvellement ouvert à la circulation, la même source informe que le tarif pour la même catégorie de véhicule est de 3 000 FCFA sur 100 km, soit 30 FCFA par kilomètre. A lire aussi : Autoroute Mbour–Fatick–Kaolack : ouverture définitive à la circulation ce samedi « Les redevances du péage actuellement appliquées répondent à une logique de tarifs sociaux, étudiés pour garantir l'accessibilité au plus grand nombre. La SN ADS SA invite le grand public à ne pas relayer ces rumeurs infondées et à se référer exclusivement aux canaux d'information officiels de la société », conclut la note. Mariama DIEME

items.title: Galamsey: Ghana’s rivers cannot afford another failed experiment – Akwasi Konadu
items.description: The Member of Parliament for Manhyia North and former Deputy Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Akwasi Konadu, has called on the government to urgently review the Blue Water Guards programme following allegations of bribery and impersonation involving nine of its members. In a press statement published on his social media pages, Mr Konadu said the arrests at Manso Adubia in the Ashanti Region should serve as a wake-up call for the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) and the government. According to him, a programme established to provide community-based intelligence and support the protection of Ghana’s water bodies must not become an avenue through which illegal miners can compromise enforcement operations. He warned that if information can be bought or enforcement movements compromised, the entire anti-galamsey architecture could be weakened. Mr Konadu therefore questioned the continued expansion of the programme, noting that the government had announced the recruitment and deployment of an additional 452 Blue Water Guards, bringing the total number deployed to 2,069 across eight regions. “Numbers are not effectiveness,” he stated, insisting that the government must focus on measurable environmental outcomes rather than personnel numbers. He said government must establish who recruited and supervises the guards, how their intelligence is verified, their exact legal powers, how their movements are monitored and how allegations against them are investigated. “Ghana does not need more slogans, uniforms, task forces and ceremonial launches. Ghana needs results,” he said, adding that the government must either radically reform the programme or reconsider its continued operation in its current form.

items.title: Blue Water Guards programme failing in fight against galamsey – Manhyia North MP
items.description: The Member of Parliament for Manhyia North, Akwasi Konadu, has criticised the government’s Blue Water Guards programme, describing it as a failed initiative that is negatively affecting the fight against illegal mining. In a press statement posted on his social media pages, the former Deputy Minister for Lands and Natural Resources said the arrest of nine Blue Water Guards at Manso Adubia in the Ashanti Region over allegations of bribery and impersonating personnel of the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) should not be treated as an isolated disciplinary matter. He argued that the development raised broader questions about the design, supervision and accountability of the programme, which was established to protect Ghana’s rivers and other water bodies from the effects of illegal mining. “This is not merely a failure of nine individuals. It is a serious failure of institutional design, supervision and accountability,” he said. Mr Konadu questioned why the government was still confronted with allegations of misconduct despite previous concerns about the vulnerability of the Blue Water Guards to inducements from illegal miners. He called for an independent and comprehensive audit of the programme, including its recruitment processes, supervision structures, operational mandate, disciplinary procedures and expenditure. The Manhyia North MP said the government should measure the success of the programme by its environmental impact rather than the number of personnel recruited. “You cannot measure the success of an anti-galamsey programme by the number of people recruited. You measure it by whether the rivers are becoming cleaner, forests are being protected and illegal mining is being pushed out of vulnerable communities,” he said.

items.description: Ce lundi 24 août 2026, le jeune milieu de terrain guinéen Ousmane Diabaté s'est officiellement engagé avec le club anglais de Newcastle United pour une durée de quatre ans, assortie d'une année supplémentaire en option, a-t-on appris de source officielle. Bien qu'aucun chiffre officiel n'ait été divulgué, des medias turs indiquent que, le montant total du transfert s'élèverait à 3,1millions d'euros, dont 1,1 millions de bonus inclus. Cette signature marque l'aboutissement de l'ascension fulgurante du natif de N’Zérékoré. Transféré de la SOAR Academy vers le club turque de Gençlerbirliği SK il y a moins d’un an, Diabaté s'est rapidement imposé grâce à sa rigueur, son professionnalisme et sa grande capacité d’adaptation. Ses performances remarquées en Turquie lui ouvrent désormais les portes de la Premier League. Afin de finaliser les démarches administratives et de cumuler le nombre de matchs requis pour l'obtention de son permis de travail en Angleterre, le joueur restera en prêt à Gençlerbirliği durant la première partie de saison. Son intégration définitive au sein de l'effectif des Magpies est prévue au plus tard lors du prochain mercato hivernal.

items.title: Désertion : Mamadi Doumbouya radie 173 militaires, dont le commandant Michel Lamah
items.description: Le président de la République, Mamadi Doumbouya, a radié lundi 173 militaires des effectifs de l’armée guinéenne pour désertion. Parmi les militaires concernés figure le commandant Michel Lamah, ancien membre du Groupement des forces spéciales (GFS). Le décret est actuellement lu à la télévision nationale par le général Amara Camara, ministre secrétaire général de la Présidence de la République. Le nom de Michel Lamah est particulièrement connu du public guinéen. Des images de lui, portant des amulettes traditionnelles sur la tête, avaient largement circulé sur les réseaux sociaux le 5 septembre 2021, alors qu’il se trouvait au volant d’un véhicule, aux côtés de l’ancien président Alpha Condé, au moment des événements ayant conduit à la prise du pouvoir par le CNRD. items.title: Two elderly men arrested over alleged attempted rape of 12-yr-old
items.description: By Ike Uchechukwu, Calabar Cross River State Police Command has arrested two elderly men, aged 68 and 70, over the alleged attempted rape of a 12-year-old girl in Calabar. The incident, Vanguard gathered, occurred at Thomas Henshaw Street, Calabar South LGA in Cross River State and the arrest was carried out following a petition by the victim’s father. The suspects, identified as Moris Monday, a shoe repairer, and Asuquo Effiom, were apprehended on Saturday, August 23, 2026, after community members handed them over to police at Hawkins Road, near Thomas Henshaw Junction. In a statement, the Command’s Public Relations Officer, ASP Sunday Eitokpah, said investigations revealed the minor alleged that Monday lured her into his room on two separate occasions on August 13 and 14 where he allegedly attempted to sexually assault her. “Preliminary investigation indicates that the victim alleged that Moris Monday, on two separate occasions, allegedly lured her into his room and attempted to sexually assault her,” Eitokpah said. He added that a second suspect was later implicated similarly. “She further alleged that on 22 August 2026, Asuquo Effiom similarly lured her into his room and attempted to sexually assault her,” the police spokesman stated. Eitokpah disclosed that detectives moved swiftly to the scene upon receiving the complaint and found the suspects already in the custody of community members before taking them into police custody. “Following receipt of the complaint, Police investigators proceeded to the Hawkins Road, where the suspects were found in the custody of community members and were taken into Police custody,” he said. According to the PPRO, both suspects have volunteered statements denying the allegations, while the victim has been referred to a government-approved medical facility for examination. “The suspects have made statements to the Police and denied the allegations. The victim has been referred to a government-approved medical facility for medical examination,” Eitokpah said. He confirmed that the case has been transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department (SCID) for discreet investigation and necessary legal action, assuring residents of professional handling. “The Command assures the public that the matter will be handled professionally and in accordance with the law. Further developments will be communicated as the investigation progresses,” he said. The post Two elderly men arrested over alleged attempted rape of 12-yr-old appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Barham Diop, une vie au service du savoir et du rayonnement de Médina Baye
items.description: À Médina Baye, certaines figures ont marqué de leur empreinte l’histoire de la Fayda Tijaniyya et contribué à son rayonnement bien au-delà du Sénégal. Oustaz Ibrahima Mahmoud Diop, connu sous le nom d'Oustaz Barham Diop, en est la parfaite illustration. Érudit de grande stature, proche compagnon et secrétaire particulier de Cheikh al-Islam, El Hadji Ibrahima Niass, il fut à la fois un homme de savoir, un confident, un acteur du dialogue religieux et un infatigable ambassadeur de la pensée de Baye Niass. Par son érudition, ses voyages, ses conférences et ses relations avec les grands foyers intellectuels du monde musulman, il contribua à faire de Médina Baye une référence spirituelle et intellectuelle au-delà des frontières. Né en 1932, Barham Diop grandit dans l’environnement intellectuel de Médina Baye, où l’apprentissage du Coran et des sciences islamiques occupait une place centrale. Il s’initia notamment au fiqh, à la langue arabe et aux grands textes classiques. Certains travaux consacrés à son parcours indiquent qu’il fut notamment formé auprès de Serigne Ahmadou Tidiane Thiam, dit Baye Amadou Thiam, réputé pour son enseignement de l’arabe et des sciences islamiques. Dans cet univers de transmission du savoir de maître à disciple, il forgea progressivement une solide culture religieuse qui allait faire de lui l’un des grands érudits de son époque. Son parcours intellectuel prit une dimension exceptionnelle dans sa relation avec Baye Niass. Le maître suivait son apprentissage, orientait ses lectures et accompagnait sa progression. Au fil des années, la relation pédagogique se transforma en une profonde relation de confiance. Barham Diop devint le secrétaire particulier de Baye Niass, l’accompagna dans plusieurs de ses déplacements et participa à différentes initiatives de son maître. Il fut ainsi placé au cœur d’une œuvre dont le rayonnement dépassait déjà largement les frontières du Sénégal. Baye Niass, son « unique université » Certains témoignages rapportent qu’il considérait Baye Niass comme son « unique université ». Cette formule traduit la place exceptionnelle que son maître occupait dans sa formation intellectuelle et spirituelle. Elle ne signifie nullement que Barham Diop était dépourvu de formation : son parcours reposait sur l’étude du Coran, du fiqh, de la grammaire arabe et des grands textes islamiques. Sa maîtrise de l’arabe et du français lui donna ensuite les moyens de porter cette connaissance devant des publics et dans des espaces très différents. Proche de Baye Niass, Barham Diop ne fut pas seulement un témoin de son œuvre. Il en fut aussi l’un des relais. Après la disparition de son maître, il poursuivit avec constance la mission de transmission et assuma notamment des responsabilités au sein de la Jamhiyatu Ansarud-Dîn, organisation liée aux disciples et sympathisants de Baye Niass. Ses activités, ses rencontres et ses conférences contribuèrent à maintenir les liens entre Médina Baye et les différentes communautés de la Fayda Tijaniyya à travers le monde. Le Maroc occupa une place particulière dans cette trajectoire. Barham Diop y noua des relations étroites avec des responsables religieux, des intellectuels et des universitaires. Pendant plusieurs années, il participa aux rencontres et conférences religieuses et scientifiques organisées dans le Royaume durant le mois de Ramadan. A lire aussi : Médina Baye : Imam Assane Cissé, la voix qui a porté la Fayda au-delà des frontières Des travaux universitaires le présentent comme une personnalité ayant contribué au rapprochement intellectuel, religieux et culturel entre le Sénégal et le Maroc. Son éloquence, sa maîtrise de l’arabe et sa connaissance approfondie des sciences islamiques lui conférèrent une audience qui dépassait largement le cercle des disciples de Baye Niass. Son influence s’exprima également à travers ses nombreuses conférences. Il prit la parole dans plusieurs pays d’Afrique, mais aussi en Europe et aux États-Unis. Ses interventions portaient notamment sur la Tijaniyya, la spiritualité islamique et la pensée de Baye Niass. Des témoignages universitaires évoquent notamment ses interventions à Médina Baye autour de la Salat al-Fatih et des enseignements de la Tijaniyya. Par sa parole, Barham Diop contribua à faire circuler le savoir et à inscrire Médina Baye dans des réseaux intellectuels et spirituels dépassant largement l’espace ouest-africain. Son parcours international trouva son dernier chapitre au Maroc. Barham Diop s’éteignit à Rabat le 24 juin 2014, à l’âge de 82 ans. Sa disparition suscita une vive émotion au Sénégal comme au Maroc. En témoignage de considération, le Royaume facilita le rapatriement de sa dépouille vers le Sénégal à bord d’un avion spécialement affrété. Il fut ensuite inhumé à Médina Baye, la cité à laquelle il avait consacré une grande partie de son existence. Après sa disparition, sa mémoire continua d’être entretenue à travers différentes initiatives. L’association « Sopey Oustaz Barham Diop » s’est notamment investie dans des actions sociales et citoyennes, parmi lesquelles des opérations de don de sang menées avec des disciples de Baye Niass de l’Université Cheikh Anta Diop de Dakar. Ces initiatives prolongent l’image d’un homme pour qui le savoir devait servir la communauté et contribuer au bien collectif. Le parcours de Barham Diop permet de comprendre une dimension essentielle du rayonnement de Médina Baye. La cité ne s’est pas imposée uniquement par la ferveur de ses disciples ou l’ampleur de ses rassemblements religieux. Son influence s’est également construite grâce à des hommes de savoir capables de transmettre, de voyager, de dialoguer avec d’autres traditions intellectuelles et de porter son message dans les grands espaces du monde musulman. Disciple fidèle, proche collaborateur et secrétaire particulier de Baye Niass Barham Diop appartient pleinement à cette histoire. Disciple fidèle, proche collaborateur et secrétaire particulier de Baye Niass, il fut également un érudit de grande envergure, un conférencier reconnu et un acteur important du dialogue religieux et intellectuel entre le Sénégal et le reste du monde. Son parcours témoigne d’une fidélité transformée en mission : recevoir le savoir d’un maître, l’approfondir, le transmettre et contribuer à son rayonnement. Du Sénégal au Maroc, de l’Afrique à l’Europe et aux États-Unis, sa voix a accompagné l’expansion de l’héritage de Baye Niass. Son itinéraire raconte ainsi une histoire de savoir, de fidélité, de transmission et d’ouverture, mais aussi celle d’un homme qui a contribué, à son époque, à donner à Médina Baye une dimension internationale. Barham Diop n’est donc pas seulement l’un des disciples de Baye Niass. Il est l’une des grandes figures qui ont accompagné l’expansion de son œuvre et contribué à donner à Médina Baye une dimension internationale. Son parcours appartient pleinement à la grande histoire intellectuelle et spirituelle de la cité. Papa Abdoulaye Sy

items.title: Zondoma/Boussou : 500 ménages vulnérables identifiés pour un appui en semences maraîchères
items.description: Burkina/Zondoma-Identifications-Personnes-Vulnérables Zondoma/Boussou : 500 ménages vulnérables identifiés pour un appui en semences maraîchères Boussou, 19 août 2026 (AIB) – L'identification et l'enregistrement des bénéficiaires d'un appui en semences maraîchères pour la campagne sèche 2026-2027 se sont déroulés, le mercredi 19 août 2026 à Boussou, dans la province du Zondoma. L'opération a été menée par le Comité International de la Croix-Rouge (CICR). Cet appui cible en priorité les personnes déplacées internes, les retournés et les résidents vulnérables installés à Boussou, pour qui la saison sèche s'accompagne habituellement d'un arrêt de l'activité agricole et d'une baisse des revenus du ménage. Les semences à distribuer doivent permettre à ces familles d'exploiter les puits maraîchers et points d'eau de la localité pour produire une partie de leur alimentation durant cette période. Au terme de la journée, 500 ménages ont été enregistrés dans la commune de Boussou pour bénéficier de cet appui. L'exercice s'est tenu en présence du président de la délégation spéciale de Boussou, Alassane Demsili, d'un volontaire de la Croix-Rouge Burkinabè (CRBF) venu de Gourcy, Tahirou Ouédraogo, et de deux volontaires CRBF de la commune. Le comité communal d'identification, composé de chefs de terre, de représentants des personnes déplacées et des retournés, d'une représentante des femmes et de producteurs maraîchers locaux, a également pris part à l'opération. Les critères retenus ont privilégié les ménages les plus exposés : familles avec enfants de moins de cinq ans, femmes enceintes, personnes à mobilité réduite, femmes cheffes de ménage, ou encore ménages ayant des enfants sortis de programmes de prise en charge de la malnutrition. La disponibilité d'une terre cultivable et d'un accès à l'eau en saison sèche constituait une condition supplémentaire. En marge de l'enregistrement, une séance de sensibilisation a été menée à l'endroit des bénéficiaires. Elle portait sur la bonne exploitation des ressources en eau disponibles en saison sèche, notamment les puits maraîchers, cours d'eau et barrages, dans un souci d'accès durable à l'irrigation pour l'ensemble des ménages producteurs de la commune. Chaque ménage retenu recevra un kit de semences de chou, tomate, oignon et d’aubergine. La distribution est annoncée pour septembre 2026. Agence d’information du Burkina JMK-DNK

items.title: We will vet Mahama Ayariga fearlessly – Minority Leader
items.description: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin has pledged that the Minority in Parliament will subject the nomination of outgoing Majority Leader Mahama Ayariga to thorough scrutiny when he appears before the Appointments Committee. Mahama Ayariga has been nominated as Minister-designate for Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs. Speaking during Parliament’s emergency recall sitting on Monday, August 24, 2026, Afenyo-Markin said the Minority would critically examine the nomination without fear or favour. “On Mahama Ayariga’s nomination as Minister for Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, we look forward to critically examining that nomination fearlessly at the Appointments Committee,” he said. The Minority Leader said the nominee must demonstrate that he is prepared to address the sanitation challenges confronting the country if approved for the position. “We hope he arrives at that ministry equipped to confront the filth that has overtaken our cities and towns. Filth must no longer sit at the door of government for failing to enact a sanitation policy,” Afenyo-Markin stated. Despite his warning of rigorous scrutiny, Afenyo-Markin adopted a cordial tone as he reflected on his relationship with Ayariga. He said he would personally miss the outgoing Majority Leader and expressed his respect and appreciation for their friendship and exchanges on the floor of Parliament. “Mr. Speaker, personally I am filled with nostalgia. This is a man I have always respected and I will dearly miss him in our usual banter on this House floor. Mahama, I respect you. I have enjoyed our friendship,” he said. Afenyo-Markin added that although their parliamentary exchanges were sometimes misconstrued by the media, the two politicians understood the nature of their relationship. “The media sometimes misconstrues the exchanges but you and I know what we know,” he said. He congratulated Ayariga on his nomination and wished him success in his new role.

items.description: L’Algérie et le Mali franchissent une nouvelle étape dans leur réconciliation après une rupture qui a duré plus d’une année. Prochaine étape : la visite à Alger du président de la transition malienne, le général d'armée Assimi Goïta. L’annonce a été faite ce lundi à Alger par le Premier ministre malien Abdoulaye Maïga à l’issue de sa rencontre avec le président de la République, Abdelmadjid Tebboune. Dans une déclaration à la Télévision algérienne, il a indiqué avoir transmis un message de « remerciements » de la part d’Assimi Goïta au président Tebboune pour « l’avoir invité à effectuer une visite en Algérie ». « Le président Goïta a considéré cette invitation comme un signe d’affection et d’appréciation à son égard personnellement, ainsi qu’envers le peuple malien frère, puisqu’il a naturellement exprimé son accord pour effectuer cette visite officielle en Algérie, si Dieu le veut, pourvu que sa date soit fixée par les voies diplomatiques habituelles », a-t-il dit. M. Maïga, qui a été accueilli ce lundi matin à l’aéroport d’Alger par le Premier ministre Sifi Ghrieb, avant de l’accompagner en fin de journée pour son retour à Bamako, a repris ce qu’a dit le président Goïta dans son message au président Tebboune. Le Premier ministre malien applaudit les positions de l’Algérie Selon lui, le président de la transition malienne est d’accord avec le président Tebboune sur le fait que le « Mali et l'Algérie partagent la même géographie », et qu’ils ne peuvent « ni changer ni ignorer cette réalité ». Pour M. Goïta, cela signifie qu’il faut « avancer et travailler ensemble pour assurer la prospérité des peuples des deux pays ». En plus des liens géographiques, l’Algérie et le Mali partagent une « histoire commune ». « Tout au long de l'histoire, nos peuples se sont engagés dans des luttes communes pour la libération, la résistance au néocolonialisme et la défense de la dignité humaine, et plus généralement de la dignité africaine », a dit le président de l’État malien dans son message à Abdelmadjid Tebboune. M. Maïga a souligné la conviction de Goïta et Tebboune de « faire de la région une oasis de paix, exempte de toute forme de néocolonialisme, d’hégémonie et de terrorisme », et a salué la position de l’Algérie de « non-ingérence dans les affaires intérieures du Mali ». L’article À Alger, le Premier ministre malien officialise la visite d’Assimi Goïta en Algérie est apparu en premier sur TSA .

items.title: Afenyo-Markin sues Sammy Gyamfi and others over alleged extortion claims
items.description: Minority Leader in Parliament, Alexander Afenyo-Markin, has taken legal action against the Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), Sammy Gyamfi, and three others over allegations he says are defamatory and intended to damage his reputation. Mr Afenyo-Markin disclosed the development on the floor of Parliament on Monday, August 24, 2026, as the House resumed sitting amid an escalating public dispute between him and the GoldBod CEO. The Effutu Member of Parliament said the suits followed allegations made against him in connection with his scrutiny of GoldBod and the Bank of Ghana’s Domestic Gold Purchase Programme (DGPP). Mr Afenyo-Markin told Parliament that two separate suits had been filed. According to him, Suit No. GT/1029/2026, titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin v. Samuel Adu Gyamfi and Multimedia Group Limited , had been filed at the Accra High Court. He said a second action, Suit No. GR/ACH/CC/C5/02/2026, titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin v. Eric Adjei and Peace FM , had been filed at the Achimota Circuit Court. The Minority Leader said the legal action was his response to what he considered false and defamatory allegations made against him. “I have accordingly caused writs to be filed in Suit Number GT/1029/2026, titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin versus Samuel Adu Gyamfi and Multimedia Group Limited at the Accra High Court, and Suit Number GR/ACH/CC/C5/02/2026, titled Osahen Alexander Afenyo-Markin versus Eric Adjei and Peace FM at the Achimota Circuit Court,” he said. He expressed confidence that the courts would determine the matter on its merits. “I have every confidence that in the fullness of time the court will make the appropriate determination,” he added. GoldBod row The court action is the latest development in a heated political and public dispute over the financial performance of the DGPP and GoldBod’s role in the programme. Mr Afenyo-Markin has been demanding greater transparency over a reported US$1.7 billion loss under the programme. He has argued that the reported loss involves public resources and has called for detailed explanations of the transactions, including the identity of off-takers, discounts applied to gold purchases, fees earned and the factors responsible for the reported loss. Mr Gyamfi, however, has rejected the suggestion that GoldBod itself incurred the reported loss and has pushed back strongly against the Minority Leader’s claims. The disagreement subsequently moved beyond the substantive questions surrounding the gold programme, with the two men exchanging accusations and counter-accusations in the media. Mr Afenyo-Markin has maintained that his scrutiny of GoldBod is part of Parliament’s constitutional oversight responsibility and has denied any improper motive. Ready for investigation The Minority Leader also recently indicated that he was prepared to submit himself to any investigation if a formal complaint was made against him over the extortion allegation. He said he expected those making the allegation to report him to the appropriate investigative authorities so that he could respond to the claims through due process. The latest lawsuits now place the allegations before the courts, potentially shifting the dispute from the political and media arena to judicial proceedings. Mr Gyamfi has indicated that he is prepared to defend his position in court. WRIT OF SUMMONS ( OSAHENE ALEXANDER AFENYO-MARKIN Download

items.title: Trump to double tariffs on Canadian autos as trade tensions escalate
items.description: US President Donald Trump vowed Monday to double tariffs on Canadian vehicles beginning next year, as the historically friendly neighbors spiral into an escalating trade war. Trump’s threat comes after the historic North American allies failed Friday to reach a deal to avert new 50-percent US tariffs on select Canadian goods. The duties took effect Saturday, and Ottawa laid out plans for retaliation. “On January First, 2027, Tariffs on all Cars, Trucks, both large and small, Automotive Parts, and Steel, will be increased to 50%,” Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform on Monday. The current US tariff impacting Canadian autos stands at 25 percent for non-US content, while imported steel to the United States generally faces a 50-percent duty. US automakers did not immediately comment on the matter. After rejecting what he called a “bad deal,” Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced retaliatory tariffs effective September 8. These will target US steel and dairy, while also covering sectors like agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, alongside electronics. Carney said Monday that the goal of trade talks with Washington “has always been to get the best deal for Canadians, never a deal at any price or on any time frame.” “We learned that, during the negotiations, the Americans wanted to destroy our major industries — including the automotive, steel, and aluminum sectors — through unfair negotiating terms. And that is one of the main reasons why we said no,” he added. He stressed that building domestically and diversifying trade abroad has been “plan A from the start.” Over the weekend, Carney added that US negotiators also sought last-minute restrictions on Canadian trade deals with other countries. US negotiators made unacceptable “threats” to the French language and “Quebec culture” too, he said, referring to the French-speaking province in eastern Canada. At a separate event Monday, however, US Vice President JD Vance blamed Canada’s “unreasonable last-minute demands” for the deal falling through. The United States is by far Canada’s biggest trading partner, with Canadian exports to its neighbor representing 70 percent of its overall total. Canada is the United States’ second biggest trading partner in goods this year, behind Mexico, government data showed. – ‘We don’t need Canada’ – Three in four Canadians support the Carney government’s decision to walk away from trade talks, according to polling released Sunday by the Angus Reid Institute. However, the research group noted that two in five have some fear about their jobs. Ontario Premier Doug Ford criticized Trump’s tariff threat on autos, telling Ottawa’s Newstalk 580 CFRA that he could “kiss my ass.” “We’re going to go at him full steam,” Ford added. Trump lashed out at Ford online, warning of “far worse” consequences if officials did not “fall in line.” The White House had alleged “discriminatory treatment” by Canada against US alcohol, automobile and dairy products in rolling out the 50-percent tariffs. Trump delayed their implementation by three days last week as Washington and Ottawa intensified trade talks. However, both sides failed to reach an agreement after negotiations that continued late into Friday night. The latest duties hit about 5.5 percent of Canadian goods entering the United States, or some $20 billion worth of products ranging from hockey sticks to cement. Trump charged Monday that “Canada has been ripping off the United States of America for years,” adding that “we don’t need Canada, they need us.” US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told the New York Times on Saturday that the Trump administration offered to eliminate a 10-percent tariff on softwood lumber, and reduce the 25-percent autos tariff. Washington was also ready to cut steel tariffs from 50 percent to 25 percent for the majority of Canadian steel, according to Greer. Besides the tariffs fight, Washington and Ottawa also have to agree on revisions to the US-Mexico-Canada free trade agreement (USMCA) which Trump has declined to renew in its current form. Trump has also repeatedly antagonized Canadians with his threats to make Canada a US state and calling Carney and his predecessor Justin Trudeau “governor” — as if they were US politicians, not prime ministers of another country. AFP The post Trump to double tariffs on Canadian autos as trade tensions escalate appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Marème Ndiaye, une vie entre deux rives
items.description: Les mariages transfrontaliers rythment les relations de parenté entre les deux villages de Guidakhar, situés de part et d’autre des rives du fleuve Sénégal. Marème Ndiaye, la soixantaine, en est le parfait exemple. Entre son enfance et sa vie matrimoniale, elle a passé toute sa vie entre les deux villages. DAGANA – Assise dans la cour de sa maison de banco ocre, les volets noirs du bâtiment principal ouverts sur une pièce aux rideaux fleuris, Marème Ndiaye regarde droit devant elle tout en jouant avec ses petits-fils. Un foulard rose et orange, noué avec une simplicité majestueuse, encadre un visage marqué par les années et le soleil du fleuve. Les traits sont nets, le regard calme et profond, les lèvres closes dans une expression digne. Son « meulfeu », décoré de motifs de cœurs blancs, contraste avec la terre battue où reposent ses pieds. Autour d’elle, plusieurs accessoires racontent le quotidien d’un village de la rive sénégalaise. L’air est plutôt humide, signe de récentes pluies, alors que la lumière de la mi-journée occupe l’extérieur. Ici, à Guidakhar Sénégal, qui fait face à Guidakhar Mauritanie, le fleuve n’est qu’un trait d’eau et de mémoire. Marème Ndiaye est née de l’autre côté. Ou presque. Elle raconte qu’elle a vu le jour à Guidakhar Sénégal, avant de grandir dans le village jumeau mauritanien. C’est là qu’elle a fait ses humanités et tissé ses amitiés d’enfance. Puis, il y a plus de 40 ans, elle a fait le trajet inverse. Son premier fils était âgé de trois mois lorsqu’elle est arrivée définitivement sur cette rive en 1979. Le mariage était un arrangement entre proches parents : la mère de son époux et celle de son père étaient des sœurs germaines. « C’était impeccable sur les deux rives », se souvient-elle, évoquant les festivités. Les familles se sont rendu visite, les amis ont fait de même. Puis est venue la traversée en pirogue, bagages et cortège, comme on le fait encore aujourd’hui. Elle en parle comme si c’était hier. À Guidakhar Sénégal, elle a trouvé un mari employé à la Compagnie sucrière sénégalaise (Css). Elle, de son côté, s’est mise à l’agriculture avec les femmes de sa génération : champs de patate et de riz, transformation et conditionnement des produits. Une même famille Tout cela avec l’aide des enfants. Dans ce village situé à un peu plus d’une dizaine de kilomètres de Richard-Toll, « Ya Marème », comme l’appellent affectueusement ses enfants, partageait la maison avec l’épouse du grand frère de son mari. « On se tenait compagnie. Je ne me suis jamais perdue. Je n’ai jamais eu le moindre problème avec qui que ce soit », confie-t-elle. Les allers-retours vers la rive mauritanienne ont rythmé sa vie. Mariages, baptêmes, deuils. Elle y retournait volontiers, jusqu’à ce que ses jambes commencent à la trahir. La dernière fois, il y a huit mois environ, c’était pour le décès d’un cousin. Une de ses filles est mariée en Mauritanie. Toutefois, les plus jeunes, eux, traversent moins souvent. « À la moindre occasion, je leur rappelle comment il faisait bon vivre là-bas. Et ils éclatent de rire », confie la vieille dame. Marème aime sa vie d’ici ; sa progéniture n’a jamais connu de difficultés, pourtant l’autre Guidakhar lui manque. « À chaque fois que j’y vais, les amies d’enfance ne veulent pas que je rentre…et moi non plus ». Elle préfère néanmoins le village où elle a élevé ses enfants. Le rire qui accompagne cette déclaration est discret, presque protecteur. Quand on l’interroge sur les jeunes femmes qui, comme elle, perpétuent la tradition des mariages transfrontaliers, elle insiste sur le fait de porter haut le drapeau de la fraternité. « Nos deux villages, c’est une même famille. Il faut multiplier les efforts, ne pas lésiner sur le maintien des bons liens, comme nous, les anciennes, l’avons fait depuis notre arrivée ». Puis, la voix se brise un peu. Son mari n’est plus de ce monde. A lire aussi : Sénégal – Mauritanie : Guidakhar, quand le fleuve refuse de séparer « Il me manque énormément. L’ambiance était toujours trop bonne avec lui. Il a laissé un vide immense », partage-t-elle, priant pour que Dieu illumine sa tombe et lui ouvre les portes du paradis. Marème Ndiaye reste assise sous la tente dans la cour de la maison. Derrière elle, les volets noirs, le rideau fleuri, le fleuve invisible, mais toujours présent. Deux villages du même nom, une même mémoire, une femme qui a traversé et qui, malgré les jambes lourdes, continue de relier les deux rives par la parole et par le souvenir. Par Tidiane SOW (Correspondant)

items.title: ‘Don’t be overwhelmed by Tinubu’s appointment’ – PDP tells Yari
items.description: By Luminous Jannamike The Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, on Monday, dismissed Senator Abdul’Aziz Yari’s projection that the All Progressives Congress, APC, will retain the presidency beyond 2031, accusing the newly appointed Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council of getting carried away by his new position. The party said Yari should first prove his mettle by delivering the mandate given to him by President Bola Tinubu before making projections about elections that are still years away. Jungudo Haruna Mohammed, National Publicity Secretary of the PDP, told Vanguard in Abuja that Yari was being ‘overzealous’ with the appointment. “I think the Senator is simply being overzealous with the appointment given to him by Mr President as Director-General,” he said. “At the moment, he should focus more on how he can deliver on the mandate given to him before talking about 2031. For now, he should concentrate on that rather than making statements that are not even right.” Jungudo also rejected any suggestion that the opposition had already conceded the 2027 presidential contest or the presidency beyond 2031 to the ruling party. “As to whether the opposition has already conceded 2027 to Mr President or is even conceding power to the APC beyond 2031, no, no, no, not at all,” he said. “That is a topic for discussion another day. For now, we are mainly concentrating on the forthcoming elections.” He further warned Yari against allowing his appointment to get into his head. “He should not be overwhelmed by this singular honour given to him by the President. He should relax, concentrate and focus on the mandate given to him by Mr President,” Jungudo said. Yari, a former governor of Zamfara State, had made the controversial projection at the Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, after returning from an overseas trip. The post ‘Don’t be overwhelmed by Tinubu’s appointment’ – PDP tells Yari appeared first on Vanguard News .
